messages:
anna_cs: Quick update — NovaRetail onboarding health check: we’re seeing ~2.1x p99 on chat/generate for longer contexts (>=1024 tokens) vs baseline. Customer is on prod and starting to scale next week, flagging renewal risk if latency stays high. :warning:

jamal_eng: thanks for flagging. Any spikes tied to specific routes or model versions?

anna_cs: looks correlated to `model: redwood/llama-13b-v1` + long history. Throughput steady but tail latency climbs during bursty peak windows. Logs show repeated KV cache misses for similar prefixes.

lina_ml: that smells like cache fragmentation + memory pressure. Two quick levers: 1) compact/int8 model swap for user-facing route, 2) split routing: short-context -> compact-7b, long-context -> 13b but pinned to high-memory pool with warmed KV cache.

rachel_sre: agree. Also suggest prefix caching tweak + increase max_batch_delay for the 13b pool to improve packing. We should canary the model swap to avoid quality regressions.

anna_cs: proposed plan to share with NovaRetail next: - Canary compact model for 15% of traffic (10k reqs/day) for 72h - Route tails (>1024 tokens) to reserved high-memory nodes with warmed cache - Apply `prefix_cache: true` and `max_batch_delay_ms: 15` on the 13b pool - Monitor p50/p95/p99, error rate, cost delta, and a small eval prompt set for semantic parity

jamal_eng: sounds good. Quick rollout config draft (canary):

```yaml
rollout_policy:
  - name: compact-canary
    match:
      header: x-novaretail-canary
    route:
      model: redwood/compact-7b-v1
      percent: 15
  - name: tail-reserve
    match:
      condition: request.token_count > 1024
    route:
      pool: nova-highmem-13b
      fallback: redwood/compact-7b-v1
      max_batch_delay_ms: 15
```

lina_ml: also add a lightweight eval harness: 20 golden prompts + 5 hallucination-check prompts. We'll compute similarity and accept if degradation < 2% on the golden set.

anna_cs: i'll propose this in the customer touchpoint tomorrow and ask for permission to run the canary. If they approve, can we get infra ready?

rachel_sre: we can reserve the highmem pool for the window. opsbot, can you reserve 2 nodes in `us-west-2` highmem-13b for 72h starting when we flip canary?

opsbot: Reservation request received: reserving 2 x highmem-13b nodes in us-west-2 for 72 hours. ETA: nodes ready in ~18 minutes. Reservation ID: res-618246. :white_check_mark:

jamal_eng: nice. After canary, if metrics look good, we can gradually increase to 40% and then 100% over 48 hours. Also remind CS to capture customer feedback on quality (two short manual checks).

anna_cs: will capture feedback and share the eval results in this thread. Also adding a short checklist for the customer: 1) expect minor BLEU-style variance, 2) keep the canary header for affected requests, 3) report any semantic mismatches to me directly.

lina_ml: one more ask — create a short prioritized alert for p99 > 2x baseline AND semantic-failure-rate > 1% so we can auto-rollback if both coincide.

rachel_sre: done, i’ll add the composite alert to the escalation policy.

anna_cs: thanks all — i’ll update NovaRetail and post customer approval here. :pray:

opsbot: Canary start signal logged at 6182468200. Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.dev/dashboards/novaretail-canary

anna_cs: canary started — diverting 15% now. tagging this thread for visibility. :eyes:

jamal_eng: monitoring p95/p99 now. will post hourly snapshots.

lina_ml: standing by to compute eval after 6h.

anna_cs: last note — renewal lead notified about proactive ops; this helps mitigate churn risk. Keeping fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
